core_rule: Public-source evidence and de-identified service telemetry may be used for product improvement. Raw private repositories, personal financial records, credentials, account numbers, unpublished inventions, and other sensitive customer content are excluded from shared-model training and public case studies by default unless the customer gives separate affirmative permission.
retention_principle: Retain only as long as reasonably necessary for delivery, verification, support, security, contracts, accounting, dispute resolution, and legal obligations; prefer de-identified derived metrics over unnecessary raw customer content for improvement datasets.
global_privacy_control: Honor recognized opt-out preference signals where legally required if future processing constitutes sale, sharing, or targeted advertising.
high_stakes_boundary: Truth Compiler outputs are not intended to be the sole basis for natural-person eligibility decisions involving credit, housing, employment, insurance, medical care, criminal justice, or other legally protected high-stakes opportunities.
